name: Dialog
purpose: Presents a blocking task in a modal on large screens and a bottom sheet on compact screens.
scenarios: Collect a short form without leaving the page

triggerLabel.description: Accessible name of the element that opens the dialog.

description.description: Supporting text associated with the dialog.

closeLabel.description: Accessible name of the close action.

states.name: closed
states.description: Not shown; trigger is in the tab order.

states.name: open
states.description: Shown; focus is trapped until dismiss.

antiPatterns: Do not trap focus without an Escape or close control.

keyboard: Escape closes and restores trigger focus
a11y.focus: Focus moves into the dialog on open and returns to the trigger on close. Delegated to Ark UI / Zag.
a11y.labeling: Title labels the dialog; description is associated.

responsive.strategy: Centered modal on medium/large; compact uses a block-end bottom sheet. Escape dismisses at every breakpoint. Morph is container-driven via the viewport-sized positioner (@container 48rem == tablet).

breakpoints.compact: Bottom sheet: content docks to block-end, full inline size, start-edge radii only.

rtl.strategy: Logical inset, padding, and action alignment. Close control is not mirrored. Direction inherits from document lang/dir.
